import hashlib, json, re, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
root = Path('products/services/wordpress-migration-paid-pilot')
raw = (root / 'raw/jobs-feed.xml').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == '1bb67a313c599686ab3d9451fdcb10fe647cef66cc461967aee57f40006b8797'
assert not re.search(rb'<!\s*(DOCTYPE|ENTITY)\b', raw, re.I)
channel = ET.fromstring(raw).find('channel')
assert channel is not None, 'Expected an RSS channel'
items = channel.findall('item')
terms = re.compile(r'\bmigrat\w*|\bimport\w*|\bexport\w*|\bredirect\w*|\bWXR\b', re.I)
pointers = []
for index, item in enumerate(items):
    matches = set()
    for field in item:
        if field.tag.rsplit('}', 1)[-1] in {'title', 'description', 'encoded', 'category'}:
            matches.update(word.lower() for word in terms.findall(' '.join(field.itertext())))
    if not matches:
        continue
    link = urlsplit(item.findtext('link', '').strip())
    if link.scheme == 'https' and link.netloc == 'jobs.wordpress.net' and re.fullmatch(r'/job/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/?', link.path):
        pointers.append({'item_index': index, 'original_listing': 'https://jobs.wordpress.net' + link.path, 'feed_date': item.findtext('pubDate'), 'matched_terms': sorted(matches)})
result = {'source': 'https://jobs.wordpress.net/feed/', 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'items_screened': len(items), 'pointers': pointers, 'scope': 'Keyword screen of one saved RSS feed. Original listings, current status, paid scope and eligibility require separate verification.'}
path = root / 'feed-migration-pointers.json'
path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'items_screened': len(items), 'pointers': len(pointers), 'artifact': str(path)}))
